@Mohammed You can do this now.
If using CCNet, you need version 1.4.3 or above and you will need BigVisibleCruise2 (a "fork" of Ben’s original version) – at bigvisiblecruise.codeplex.com .
With BVC2 you can also setup photos/images of the build breaker to show on the screen using the new skin "StackPhoto"
